CustomField.description: The icon or image shown on each option's card when a picklist uses the Visual Picker display type. Edited in Form Builder's Customize Visual Picker window and stored as JSON mapping each API value to an icon (such as utility:favorite) or a public image asset. Options without an entry show a default icon. Option wording still comes from the custom option labels, so translations and merge fields keep working.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Maps picklist values to the icon or public image asset shown on their visual picker card, managed from the Customize Visual Picker editor in Form Builder. Values without an entry show a default icon; option labels are still managed alongside the media in the same editor.
CustomField.label: Picklist Visual Picker Options
